source_units.text: I inherited a box of old coins and want to learn how cataloguers describe them.
Create a study schedule for identification.
Keep the timetable within the window ending 2027-02-06, with the end date included.
Required coverage is "Mint Marks", "Coin Legends", "Die Varieties".
The minimum study allocation for each topic is 10 minutes across all dates.
My daily study allowance is 65 minutes maximum, not 65 minutes per topic.
